username.label: [%key:common::config_entries::username::label%]
username.description: Your username for the MusicFree server

password.label: [%key:common::config_entries::password::label%]
password.description: The password associated with the username

baseURL.label: Base URL
baseURL.description: Base URL for the MusicFree server, e.g. http://192.168.1.100

port.label: Port
port.description: Port number for the MusicFree server

path.label: Server Path
path.description: Path to append to the base URL, e.g. /rest. Usually empty unless behind a proxy.

enable_podcasts.label: Enable Podcasts
enable_podcasts.description: Should the provider query for podcasts as well as music?

recommend_favorites.label: Recommend Favorites
recommend_favorites.description: Should favorited (starred) items be included as recommendations.

recommend_new.label: Recommend New Albums
recommend_new.description: Should new albums be included as recommendations.

recommend_played.label: Recommend Most Played
recommend_played.description: Should most played albums be included as recommendations.

recommendation_count.label: Recommendation Limit
recommendation_count.description: How many recommendations from each enabled type should be included.

request_raw_file.label: No Transcoding For Streams
request_raw_file.description: Request that the server provide the original source file without applying any transcoding rules.

pagination_size.label: Items per request
pagination_size.description: How many items to request per server call. Smaller is better for low bandwidth. Max 500.

manifest.description: Connect to a MusicFree (music-free-site) server via the OpenSubsonic API.

errors.connect_failed: Failed to connect to {0}, check your settings.
errors.create_playlist_failed: Failed to create playlist with name '{0}'.
